# Template migrations

One entry per template version, newest first. An entry lists what a project must do to move from the previous version;
"nothing" is a valid entry. An entry is written so that it can be used as the brief of a run.

## Unreleased (after 1.7.0; written with each change, owner 2026-10-31; the release moves it under its number)
- 2026-10-31, the README's pictures: `README.md` six `<img>` lines at `width="100%"` (03a7f09); a project with `docs/template/README.md` rewrites it from the template's README as 1.6.0 says.
- 2026-10-31, the vault's global decisions: `templates/vault/rules.md` (a global decision is a neutral rule, never a quote; only a proven one enters; `proof:`; the way in on the owner's yes, the way out by `would_change_if`), `templates/vault/ops/check_pages.py` (`PROOF_FROM`: a global page decided from 2026-10-31 needs an existing `proof:` page under `context/`), `ops/tests/test_new_vault.py` (aa4520f, 834b9c3, daa0ec8, c78959f). Steps: copy the three paths; a vault made from the form before this change takes the `rules.md` paragraphs and the `check_pages.py` block by hand (the form does not update a vault).
- 2026-10-31, the template's own records (never copied): `specs/005-spec-writer-rule/spec.md` wording, `.raw/`, `wiki/` ledgers (a73258b, ef0e847).
- 2026-10-31, `docs/template/MIGRATIONS.md`: the `## 1.7.0` heading restored (4b80007 had replaced it with the Unreleased heading, so the 1.7.0 bullets sat under Unreleased; found by the gd170 verifier, N1).
- 2026-10-31, `templates/vault/rules.md`: a global page is a lesson (proof mandatory) or an order (the owner's standing decision, no proof, never deleted for lack of one); the template holds them in copy-only paths. Copy the file.
- Checks: `uv run pytest -q ops/tests/test_new_vault.py`, `uv run harness docs-check`.
- Breaks active runs: no.

- Steps: finish or abort the active runs and pipelines, or keep one and refreeze it at the end; in the template, `git log --format='%h %s' -- docs/template/VERSION` names the 1.6.0 and 1.7.0 commits, and `git diff --stat <1.6.0> <1.7.0> -- <path>` shows each path's change; copy the paths above from the template at 1.7.0 over the project's, but merge these by hand, keeping the project's lines and adding the template's: `ARCHITECTURE.md`, `docs/llms.txt`, `docs/template/variables.yaml` (`skip:` gains `.raw/captured/` if it is not there yet), `wiki/index.md` (it stays at most 12,000 bytes: shorten one of the project's own lines where the template's two do not fit), `wiki/log.md` and `wiki/hot.md` (the project's own record of its vault: the template's entries about its own pages are not added); in the settings files of the project's own role sessions (the copies of the skill's `example/*-settings.json`, under a run folder's `_control/`) add under `env` `"CLAUDE_CODE_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL": "5m"` for a builder, a writer and a planner and `"1h"` for a verifier, a critic, a plan fixer and a judge (the harness's stage types keep the hour that `docs/roles/need-to-know.yaml` sets); in a pipeline file of the project's own, the spec stage's output `output/technical-brief.md` becomes `output/spec.md` and the inputs of the plan, write and validate stages follow, and a brief of the project's own for that stage asks for the skeleton (intent, requirements, limits, done, out of scope) and no data model, interfaces or tests; a project script that reads `usage_report.py` rows by column position follows the three new dollar columns (`rd $`, `wr $`, `out $`; the total row's last field is unchanged); after committing the copy, run `python3 -I ops/obsidian-ingest.py --dry-run <page>` and then `python3 -I ops/obsidian-ingest.py <page>` for every page new under `wiki/decisions/` (`spec-writer-writes-the-skeleton.md` and `the-cache-is-measured-in-dollars-and-set-per-role.md`), and `python3 -I ops/obsidian-ingest.py --supersede <page>` (dry run first) for a page of the template's that changed after the project ingested it (none changed at 1.7.0); `uv sync`; `uv run harness catalog`; `uv run harness refreeze` for each run kept
- Checks: `uv run ruff check .`, `uv run ruff format --check .`, `uv run pytest -q`, `uv run harness eval --suite regression --baseline --threshold 1.0`, `uv run harness validate`, `uv run harness loop validate`, `uv run harness audit --ci`, `uv run harness wiki-lint`, `uv run harness docs-check`, `uv run harness plan-lint`, `claude plugin validate .claude/skills`, `python3 ops/adopt-obsidian.py lint`, `python3 -I .claude/skills/running-specagent-pipelines/scripts/check_formats.py --help`
- Breaks active runs: yes: they need `harness refreeze` (`config_changed`: `.claude/agents` and `.claude/skills` changed); a run whose spec stage finished before the change holds `output/technical-brief.md`, while the plan, write and validate stages now read `output/spec.md`, so it reruns the spec stage or finishes on 1.6.0; the spec stage's gate now checks five sections (intent, requirements, limits, done, out of scope) and no longer the data model, flows, interfaces, tests, risks and files-to-change sections, the constitution rows or the paths of the files to change; `usage_report.py` rows have three new dollar columns (`rd $`, `wr $`, `out $`; the total row is unchanged), the role table of `score_run.py` has three (`read $`, `write $`, `output $`) and its economy row one more ("cache write $ per unit"), so a project script that reads them by column position must follow

## 1.1.0

- Steps: replace `harness-internal` with `<repo_name>-plugins` in the four configuration files; run
  `python3 ops/bootstrap.py --wait`; then, in the checkout, `claude plugin uninstall <plugin>@harness-internal
  --scope project` for every plugin of the old name (Claude Code binds the record to the checkout's path, so before
  any move). When no other checkout on the machine still uses `harness-internal`
  (`~/.claude/plugins/installed_plugins.json`), `claude plugin marketplace remove harness-internal`, and delete
  `~/.claude/plugins/data/code-intel-harness-internal` if it is still there. Optional, to keep the runs in a container
  folder: finish the active runs; move the checkout into a folder of its own; run `uv run harness runs-root --init`
  there and move the old `<repo_name>-runs/` content into its `runs/`; `git worktree repair`; remove the moved `.venv`
  (it keeps the old paths) and run `python3 ops/bootstrap.py --wait`; accept Claude Code's trust dialog in the new
  folder.
- Checks: `uv run harness validate`, `uv run harness doctor`, `uv run harness runs-root`
- Breaks active runs: no; the optional move to a container: yes (their sessions and worktrees keep the old paths)
